plans.note: No standalone limitation-of-liability heading in the outline, but caps and consequential-damages waivers are frequently embedded in the indemnity section (sec-12); note the outline skips sections 3, 4, 6, 9 and 11, so a liability clause may sit in an unlisted section. Check mutuality and carve-outs.
Section 12 is the indemnity. Confirm TrueLink indemnifies Client for third-party IP infringement and its own misconduct, and that the Client-side indemnity in sec-12/sec-8 stays narrow.

Client covenants (sec-8) and the licence scope (sec-2) are the usual homes for business restrictions; no non-compete heading appears, so likely absent unless a covenant restricts Client's competing offerings.
Check the licence grant (sec-2) for an exclusive-hosting or sole-provider covenant and sec-8 covenants; nothing in the outline signals an exclusivity clause.
Pricing terms sit in Compensation (sec-5); scan for any best-terms/most-favoured pricing obligation running against Client. None indicated by the outline.
Non-solicits often ride alongside confidentiality (sec-10) or Client covenants (sec-8); no dedicated heading, so probably absent.

No Term/Termination heading in the supplied outline; the numbering gaps (3, 4, 6, 9, 11) suggest termination may sit in an unlisted section. Within supplied ids, only sec-2 may carry licence revocation/termination language.
Auto-renewal and renewal pricing would appear in a term clause or in Compensation (sec-5); no such heading supplied, so treat as absent pending the unlisted sections.
No general/miscellaneous section is listed; governing law and venue are not locatable in the supplied ids.
Assignment/change-of-control language would normally sit in a miscellaneous section (not supplied); check sec-2 for any transfer restriction on the licence to Client.

Licence grant (sec-2) plus defined terms (sec-1) govern ownership of the hosted site, deliverables and Client customer data; sec-10 confidentiality may also address data. Confirm no assignment of Client content or user data to TrueLink.
Section 2 is the licence grant; test scope for affiliates/contractors, territory, and any at-will revocability. Definitions in sec-1 (Hosting Services) qualify the grant.
Any audit of Client usage or records would attach to Compensation (sec-5) reporting or Client covenants (sec-8); no audit heading in the outline.
Check Compensation (sec-5) for late fees or fixed damages and the unsolicited e-mail clause (sec-7) for per-message penalties chargeable to Client.
Section 8 covers warranties of Client only; no TrueLink performance warranty or service-level heading appears among the supplied sections, though unlisted sections 9 or 11 may contain one.
No insurance heading; occasionally bundled with indemnity (sec-12) or covenants (sec-8). Expect to raise as missing for a host handling our site and user data.
Compensation (sec-5) is where minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay hosting minimums would appear; verify whether any minimum survives termination.
Return of confidential materials may appear in sec-10, but no exit/transition-assistance or data-return-on-termination clause is visible; flag as missing if the unlisted sections do not cover it.
